title: Afrikalify Music
description: A modern in-game music player with themes, queues, and Simple Voice Chat support.
body:
# Afrikalify

Afrikalify is a modern in-game music player for Minecraft, made for players who want a Spotify-like music menu directly inside the game.

Open the Afrikalify menu, search your local songs, play music, queue tracks, change the look of the GUI, and optionally mix your music into Simple Voice Chat so friends can hear it too.

## What It Offers

- Modern transparent music GUI
- Open with the keybind or through Mod Menu
- Search and play local music files
- Queue system for tracks
- Music folder button so you can quickly open where songs go
- Volume controls
- Softer sound option for smoother playback
- Simple Voice Chat support
- Configurable settings through Mod Menu
- Custom Afrikalify logo
- GUI credit: `By: BestOfAfrika`

## How It Works

Afrikalify reads music from a local folder on your computer. Put your supported music files into the Afrikalify music folder, open the menu in-game, press reload, then search and play your tracks.

The mod does not stream from Spotify or YouTube. It plays your own local music files.

For Simple Voice Chat broadcasting, enable the broadcast option inside Afrikalify. You may need to use open mic or hold your push-to-talk key so Simple Voice Chat sends audio.

## Themes

Afrikalify includes a bunch of built-in themes so you can style the menu your way:

- Emerald
- Ocean
- Rose
- Cat Pink
- Cat Mint
- Cat Lavender
- Cat Blue
- Cat Fire
- Dog
- Dog Blue
- Elephant
- Elephant Rose
- Afrika Red
- Afrika Sunset
- Sakura
- Petal Dream
- Forest
- Ice
- Lava
- Candy
- Midnight
- Gold
- Neon Gradient
- Sunset Gradient
- Afrika Gradient

Some themes include extra animated details, like cat ears, dog ears, elephant ears, gradients, and falling petals.

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Mod Menu is recommended
- Simple Voice Chat is optional, only needed for voice broadcast features

## Notes

Afrikalify is client-side focused. Other players do not need Afrikalify installed to hear music through Simple Voice Chat, but they do need to be connected to a server using Simple Voice Chat.
